blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Stopping envelope matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: The stopping envelope is the set of states from which the resident stop, after every worst-case delay, halts before the obstacle with localization, protective, and tracking margins intact, and its seven priced rows run as a per-tick speed governor.

questions.q: The section **Stopping Envelopes** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: A control barrier function makes its safe set forward invariant only if every admitted input keeps hdot >= -alpha(h), and a barrier on raw distance has relative degree two in torque, so the barrier must carry the cost to stop.

Speed and separation monitoring keeps a protective separation distance (the person's travel, the robot's reaction and stopping travel, intrusion distance, and position uncertainties) between a moving arm and a person as a certified function.

An arbiter selects directly among project, hold, controlled stop, and torque inhibit by the check that failed and the measured plant state, before the admissible set empties, so one trigger can select different rungs in motion and at standstill.

The stopping envelope is the set of states from which the resident stop, after every worst-case delay, halts before the obstacle with localization, protective, and tracking margins intact, and its seven priced rows run as a per-tick speed governor.
